title: Ukrainian Beet Fritters
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish made with beets and served as a snack or side. The earthy sweetness of beets pairs perfectly with a crispy exterior.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated beets, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix together flour and a pinch of salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the beet mixture and mix well.
Heat the fry oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the beet mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve the fritters hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill.
For a vegan option, use gluten-free flour and omit the egg from the recipe.
